title: XdrLogRaider — Defender XDR Internal Telemetry
descriptionMarkdown:
Ingests Microsoft Defender XDR portal-only telemetry (configuration, compliance, drift, exposure, posture, identity, action center, threat analytics) that is not exposed by public Microsoft Graph Security or Microsoft 365 Defender / MDE public APIs.

- **63 live data streams + 1 deprecated** (64 manifest total) grouped into 5 cadence tiers (ActionCenter 10m, XspmGraph 1h, Configuration 6h, Inventory 1d, Maintenance 1w) + 1 operational stream (XdrConnectorHealth_CL).
- **11 consolidated workspace tables** (10 `Defender_<Category>_CL` per nathanmcnulty 10-category taxonomy + 1 ops table) ingested via 13 per-category DCRs (semantic split for Configuration + Exposure) sharing 1 DCE; 65 streamDeclarations in total (64 manifest + 1 ops).
- Per-stream typed columns at ingest via DCR projection map; `RawJson` preserved on every row for forensic queries.
- Drift detection via 4 cadence-bucket KQL parsers (Configuration, Inventory, Exposure, Maintenance) using `mv-apply set_union(CurrentFields, PreviousFields)` field-level diff.
- **8 workbooks** (incl. ConnectorHealth with 9 panels: per-tier freshness, auth-chain failures, DLQ depth, freshness SLI, partial-success rate, service-account anomaly, per-stream workspace-side freshness).
- **20 analytic rules** (14 detection + 6 XdrOps incl. RowVolumeSpike cost-budget gate + DlqDepth alarm) — all ship `enabled: false` per Microsoft Sentinel Solution best practice.
- **12 hunting queries** + 4 drift parsers + **385 sample queries** (every active stream has 5-query operator anchor).
- Auth chain diagnostics in AppInsights native tables (AppRequests + AppDependencies + AppExceptions + AppTraces + AppEvents + AppMetrics) + B2 circuit-breaker (5min sliding window) + B3 DLQ-depth metric (`xdr.dlq.pending_count`).
- Unified Entra-layer auth (TOTP or Software Passkey) — single primitive for unattended production.
- Pure Defender connector — single-tenant. Multi-portal expansion + Function App multi-tenancy reintroduced in v0.2.0.

See [repo README](https://github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider) for setup, deployment, permissions, and operator runbook.

graphQueries.baseQuery: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

sampleQueries.description: Connector liveness — heartbeat in last 1h with stream success
sampleQueries.query: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where StreamsSucceeded > 0 | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 10

sampleQueries.description: Heartbeat by tier with metrics from Notes
sampleQueries.query: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend n = parse_json(Notes) | project TimeGenerated, Tier, FunctionName, StreamsSucceeded, StreamsAttempted, RowsIngested, LatencyMs, Rate429Count = toint(n.rate429Count), GzipBytes = tolong(n.gzipBytes)
AppEvents | where Name in ('AuthChain.AADSTSError', 'AuthChain.Completed', 'AuthChain.Started') | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 20

sampleQueries.description: AppExceptions with AuthChain ErrorClass — root cause auth failures
sampleQueries.query: AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Properties.ErrorClass startswith 'AuthChain.' | summarize Count = count() by ProblemId = tostring(Properties.ErrorClass), AADSTSCode = tostring(Properties.AADSTSCode) | order by Count desc

sampleQueries.description: Durable Functions orchestration correlation per heartbeat
